decisions.summary: Rack-by-the-house knob is HamletSpec.harvest_weather (settled|changeable), declared on the spec, never rolled; default settled; entry 500's drying-method knob folded into it.
decisions.why: Unchanged. FR-005: 505 finds the environment decided, so the knob is set from a stated environment input and is one knob with 500's - the GM's worry about adjacent villages in one climate differing.

decisions.summary: Sawada declares harvest_weather=changeable as the pool's exhibit.

6 x 3 ft mats in rows over the whole yard, 1 ft inset, corners 1 ft inside the drawn outline and 0.25 ft off the rack, gap 2/1.5/1/0.5 ft, each nudged up to 0.4 ft and turned up to 6 degrees by a positional draw, straw-gold with a same-hue outline, count in [ceil(full/3), floor(2 full/3)] with an even thinning; rows a GUESS, thinning and nudge a CONVENTION.
decisions.why: Matches yards.py as read 2026-09-28 (MAT_GAPS_FT = (2.0, 1.5, 1.0, 0.5), MAT_JITTER_FT 0.4, MAT_JITTER_DEG 6, fill #E4CC86 stroke #C4A45E, pad 0.25 ft). The nudge keeps the rows (FR-004's labeled guess) and serves the GM's stated aim that the drawn mats read as mats; styling is not a scope question.

decisions.summary: A yard under 400 sq ft that cannot reach a third of a full cover with a gap draws as many as fit with one (never edge to edge), at least four.
decisions.why: Narrows the accepted FR-004 floor, which was this project's proxy (spec-fidelity round 1), not the GM's number. The GM's purpose is legibility: 'we can't render dozens of mats and have that be legible. So our threshing yard glyphs show a smaller number to give the impression that there are many of them.' Holding the floor on these yards forced edge-to-edge mats, recorded as reading as paving, which defeats that purpose. Scope is bounded (under 400 sq ft; measured from the manifests 2026-09-28: four pool yards short by one or two, drawing 5-6), mats still spread over every quarter (SC-001), and tests enforce the full band at 400 sq ft and above. Same ruling as the MODE 1 check on FR-004.

decisions.summary: Rack along a side edge inset 1 ft (in the slack beside the mat rows), preferring the half nearest the house, always off the yard's MAP-south half solved in map coordinates, 2.5 ft drawn width, whole-side fallback so every changeable-weather yard takes one.
decisions.why: The side inset moved 2 -> 1 ft (RACK_SIDE_INSET_FT = 1.0 in the code); nothing in FR-006 turns on it. Map-south rule, corridor and knob unchanged.

decisions.summary: Threshing yard docstring rewritten from 025 and 505 with per-claim labels and the GM's convention wording.
Regenerate the five pool hamlets; the settlement-reviews the gate owes; make done.
